description: Create a custom visual to show the relationship between a marker layer and a polygon layer with the TMap Visual. In the process of slicing and selection, the marker layer will be dynamically linked with the polygon layer. Furthermore, the marker layer can be drilled down and drilled up by a hierarchy of polygon layers or geographic names. Some basic features is free to use. However, some advanced features need to pay license fees. When the features need additional purchase, a watermark "Free Trial" will be appeared on the background. Main features Include: The marker layer needs longitude and latitude for positioning, and can be adjusted by size and color. The data source for polygon layer can be WKT(Well-Known Text) data in data model or built-in boundary data inside the visual or uploaded shape/GeoJSON file. Markers can be shown as the following types: circle, square, triangle, hexagon, star, diamond. Grid layer can be generated from point data in the marker layer or reference layer. Contour layer can be generated from point data in the marker layer. More than 10 types of thematic map (Proportional Symbol Map, Grid-based Heat Map, Contour-based Heat Map, Pie Chart Map, Bar Chart Map, Donut Chart Map, Rose Chart Map, Stacked Bar Chart Map, Graduated Color Map, Filled Map, Classed Choropleth Map, Unclassed Choropleth Map, Symbol Choropleth Map and Chart Choropleth Map) can be…
